content.title: Spain vs Serbia Lineups, Live Streams, Cable, How & Where to Watch In the USA
content.text: Spain will be playing one of their last friendly matches before the 2026 World Cup in Spain when they host Serbia. Spain will host Serbia at the Estadio de la Ceramica.The Spanish national team qualified for the World Cup last year in the UEFA World Cup qualifiers by finishing first in their group with 16 points. Spain topped their group with a record of five wins, one draw, and zero losses.AdvertisementSpain is among the favorites to win the 2026 World Cup due to their squad. In their previous match, Spain drew 2-2 with Turkiye at home, and their two goal scorers were Dani Olmo and Mikel Oyarzabal.Dani Olmo of Spain celebrates scoring his team's first goal during the FIFA World Cup 2026 qualifier match between Spain and Türkiye at Estadio de La Cartuja on November 18, 2025 in Seville, Spain. (Photo by Juan Manuel Serrano Arce/Getty Images)Photo by Juan Manuel Serrano Arce/Getty Images (Photo by Juan Manuel Serrano Arce/Getty Images)Serbia did not qualify for the 2026 World Cup after finishing third in their UEFA World Cup qualifiers.Serbia had 13 points, but Albania advanced to the next round of the qualifiers as they finished with 14 points, and England topped the group with 24 points to qualify directly to the World Cup.AdvertisementIn their previous match, Serbia defeated Latvia 2-1 at home with goals from Aleksandar Katai and Aleksandar Stankovic.Official Lineups for Spain and SerbiaSpainGoalkeeper: Unai SimonDefenders: Marc Cucurella, Pau Cubarsi, Aymeric Laporte, Marcos LlorenteMidfielders: Pedri, Rodri, Fermin LopezForwards: Alex Baenax, Mikel Oyarzabal, Lamine YamalSerbiaGoalkeeper: Vanja Milinkovic-SavicDefenders: Aleksa Terzic, Strahinja Pavlovic, Nikola Milenkovic, Ognjen MimovicMidfielders: Nemanja Gudelj, Nemanja Gudelj, Sergej Milinkovic-SavicForwards: Filip Kostic, Aleksandar Mitrovic, Veljko BirmancevicSpain vs Serbia will kick off at 4 p.m. ET/ 1 p.m. PT in the United States. The match will kick off at 9 p.m. local time in Villarreal, Spain, at the Estadio de la Ceramica.The match will be available to watch across TV channels and streaming services in the United States and Spain.AdvertisementVix Premium (USA)RTVE/ TVE La 1 (Spain)This story was originally published by Athlon Sports on Mar 27, 2026, where it first appeared in the Soccer section.
